# Rulings

- **Pre-BiS presets take dungeon and world drops, the class's own dungeon sets, crafts without raid materials and
  vendor items, and only items the class can use; raid drops and materials, PvP and reputation rewards
  (reputation-pattern crafts and Silithus quest rewards included), other classes' quest sets, rare costly BoE world
  epics and SoD-only enchants are out, unsourced items stay flagged, and a valid item a preset already wears stays.**
  `ui/specs/warrior/dps/gear_sets/prebis_arms.gear.json`, PR #539.
- **Malleable Essence of Nature (274030) is a raid material, so every craft that needs it is out of Pre-BiS presets;
  McWeaksauce potions are PTR-only, so presets use Major Mana Potion 13444.**
  `ui/specs/warlock/dps/builds/destro.build.json`, PR #309.
